type: Current Power Stack analysis composed from canonical themes + rates overlay
evidencePolicy: The canonical theme file changes research priority, required proof and margin of safety. It does not mechanically change Base Conviction or company fundamental scores. Cranium, sell-side PDFs, positioning and transcripts remain hypothesis inputs unless independently verified.

environment.label: Restrictive, inflation-sensitive risk-on with strong physical capex but fragile financial duration
environment.currentRead: The market can remain risk-on while the cost of capital stays restrictive. The key transmission chain is now energy/products/shipping + inflation uncertainty + sovereign duration supply into long-end/real yields, which then separates funded cash-generative infrastructure from leverage-dependent duration.

highestPriorityExposure: Energy and shipping exposures with real current cash flows and direct benefit from product/logistics scarcity
Funded grid, power, electrical and cooling suppliers with visible backlog and customer commitments
Nuclear/fuel-cycle assets with operating or contracted economics rather than pre-revenue financing dependence
Selective China state-backed power/infrastructure and confirmed AI equipment rather than broad China beta
highestRequiredProof: Long-duration equities dependent on future cash flows or multiple expansion
AI/data-centre projects dependent on debt, converts, dilution or uncontracted load
Humanoid/robotics concepts without deployment and cash-conversion proof
Pre-revenue SMR and other capital-intensive projects whose economics change materially with long-end yields
portfolioRead.regimeModifier: Low index volatility and thin protection can hide wide factor/thematic fragility; do not interpret low VIX alone as a low-risk environment.
